text:
Alex: thanks for coming to the quickfire Q&A after the all-hands. I'll drop loud questions here.

Priya: ready.

Alex: 1) Short pitch for sales — how to answer "why Redwood" in one line?

Marta: "We provide a production-grade inference runtime so teams can ship LLM features without guessing about latency, cost, or reliability."

Ben: alternate: "Redwood makes serving models predictable — same API from prototype to private clouds."

Alex: 2) Is 'cost' or 'latency' the stronger hammer in GTM right now?

Priya: cost sensitivity is rising. Highlight cost controls + batching + quantization recommendations first, but lead with latency guarantees when talking to performance-sensitive apps.

Marta: add a concrete stat in decks: e.g., "typical customers cut per-token infra cost by 30% with our Optimize defaults" — needs legal approval though.

Alex: 3) Competitor nuance: what to say vs "simple API" vendors?

Ben: "They give a fast path for prototypes; we give the path to scale. If you need SLAs, private deployments, or predictable unit economics, that's our lane."

Priya: include product bullets: dedicated pools, canary rollouts, per-route tracing, KV/prefix caching.

Alex: 4) Any changes to public messaging this week?

Marta: tweak hero to call out 'Unified runtime across hosted, dedicated, private' and surface 'Cost controls' under core benefits.

Alex: 5) Tactical: sales asked for a one-paragraph leadership quote and a 2-line FAQ for the website.

Ben: quote: "Engineering teams shouldn't have to build the serving stack to use LLMs. We make inference dependable and efficient so teams can focus on product." 

Priya: FAQ lines: "Which deployment should I pick?" -> "Hosted for fast prototyping, Dedicated for steady high throughput, Private for regulated/air-gapped needs." and "How do you lower costs?" -> "Smart batching, KV caching, and model/quantization suggestions tuned to your workload."

LaunchBot: Reminder: slides & recording uploaded to #resources/all-hands.

Alex: great. I'll feed the copy to marketing and legal for approval. Closing thread in 24h unless objections.

Marta: +1. thanks everyone. :tada:

Ben: Leaving a note to Product: prepare the short stat on cost savings.

Priya: logging action item: marketing to update hero + FAQ.

Alex: closing. :white_check_mark:
